dct_description_sm: Contributors: United States. Bureau of the Census; United States. Bureau of the Census. Geography Division, cartographer
Publication statement: [Washington, D.C.] : U.S. Census Bureau, 2019.

This dataset is comprised of three shapefiles. Each shapefile shows national congressional district boundaries for the 116th Congress. The difference between the three vector shapefiles is the scalar level of generalization of the boundaries (1:500,000 being the most detailed set of boundaries).
dct_title_s: Cartographic boundary files for congressional districts : 116th Congress
